description: Refactor/optimize any SKILL.md for progressive disclosure: precise-trigger frontmatter, layered body (hard constraints vs single-run flow), a flow of five steps or fewer, permission/context declarations, and a token budget. Triggers: "optimize / refactor / slim down this SKILL.md", "make the skill trigger more precisely", "the body is too long / hard constraints get lost when the context compacts", "split this SKILL.md into a lean body plus references". Three modes: refactor (default, emits the optimized file + a changelog), audit (read-only diagnostic), and readme (polish the companion README.md - structure, badges, install, usage examples, license). NOT for: auditing the code a skill calls (skill-clean-audit), a publish-time security/compliance gate (skill-publish-gate), or from-scratch creation (skill-creator). No external network and no required secrets; the linter runs offline.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
